## YT-Chatterino 2.5.8

- Display native and third-party emotes in pinned messages.
- Follow Twitch Hype Trains in the app using the browser extension.
- Open a redesigned channel menu and view recent subscription, membership, Bits, and support activity. Gifted subscriptions can be expanded to show available recipients.

Activity is collected from events received by the app while connected. Earlier events, recipient associations that platforms do not provide, and external donations may be unavailable. Open the Twitch channel in a browser with the updated extension to share its Hype Train and pinned-message details.
